decisions.reason: As an experimental but capability-near extension of its physical-media catalog, the firm would likely keep this young series for another year while learning from demand, though its niche and uncertain fit make it more droppable if results fall below aspiration.

Because this compilation series is close to the retailer-label’s core collector-oriented offer and can use existing catalog, curation, and label resources, management is likely to retain it unless early sales clearly underperform aspiration levels.
